description: Route risk between two ports (UN/LOCODEs): a 0–100 score, risk level, the signals driving it (war-risk areas, piracy, chokepoints, weather, sanctions exposure of transited EEZs), confidence and any missing sources. Resolve port names with find_port first. Needs ARCNAUTICAL_API_KEY; 10,000 assessments a month are included with a self-serve key.

customer_reference.description: Your own reference (voyage id, fixture); echoed on the assessment

dwt_tonnes.description: Deadweight in tonnes; used for chokepoint and draught constraints

load_condition.description: laden or ballast; affects exposure on the transit

speed_knots.description: Planned service speed, 8-25 knots; sets transit time through each risk area

vessel_type.description: Vessel class; changes which threat signals weigh most (default: general)

name: score_voyage

missing_sources.description: Signals that could not be read for this assessment

title: Score a voyage route (API key)
